breaking.change: UiDesc.primaryColor is gone. The default style's whole palette is derived from seed colours (packages/design/tokens/seed.css): grounds, surfaces, lines and inks from `neutral`; the primary fill and its hover, pressed and soft tones and the ink on it from `primary`; the highlight ink, the accent role and the focus ring from `accent`; the status colours from `danger`, `warn`, `success` and `info`; the eight team colours from `team`. Each scheme keeps text at 4.5:1 and focus rings, rims and team marks at 3:1 whatever the seeds. The primary's tones are no longer mixed in Rust: they follow the seed through the stylesheet, so a style pack's `--primary-hover` or `--on-primary` stays the pack's.
breaking.fix: Give the colour as UiDesc.seeds.primary: og.ui.configure(world, { seeds: { primary: color.fromHex(0xc8102e) } }). Add `accent` for a second accent and `neutral` to tint the grounds.

added.summary: The seed colours the UI's palette is derived from (UiSeeds: primary, accent, neutral, danger, warn, success, info, team), over the style's. Calling og.ui.configure with new seeds at run time (a faction, the time of day) restyles the whole UI from the next tick.

A style pack sets the palette with seed tokens on :root (`--seed-primary`, `--seed-accent`, `--seed-neutral`, `--seed-danger`, `--seed-warn`, `--seed-success`, `--seed-info`, `--seed-team`), any CSS colour, once for both schemes; the default stylesheet derives every colour token from them as relative colours that resolve when drawn. `--team1` to `--team8` are stylesheet tokens, read back into UiTheme.tokens.team, and `--well-rim` is the `--color-well-rim` token.
